92:15.text: None shall enter it save the most wretched.

92:17.text: will be far removed from it

92:18.text: He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,

92:19.text: no favour from anyone to be paid back,

92:20.text: Except to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.

93:2.text: By the night when it darkens

93:3.text: has neither forsaken you nor hates you.

93:4.text: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present

93:5.text: And verily, your Lord will give you
so that you shall be well-pleased.

93:6.text: an orphan and gave you a refuge?

93:7.text: (of the Qur’ân, its laws, and Prophethood)

93:8.text: And He found you poor and made you rich

93:9.text: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression.

93:11.text: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord
(i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces)

94:1.text: Have We not opened your breast for you

94:2.text: And removed from you your burden.

94:4.text: And have We not raised high your fame?

94:5.text: Verily, along with every hardship is relief,

94:6.text: Verily, along with every hardship is relief
(i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs)
